headline: On November 3, 1994: Atlantis launches on STS-66
captionCards: Atlantis launched on mission STS-66 in 1994
The Space Shuttle program flew 135 missions total
instagramCaption:
Atlantis soars into space on a critical mission. \\[Blank Line] On November 3, 1994, the Space Shuttle Atlantis launched on mission STS-66, part of NASA's Space Shuttle program. This was one of 135 missions carried out by the program from 1981 to 2011, which transported 355 astronauts from 16 countries. The mission included important scientific experiments and observations. \\[Blank Line] The Space Shuttle program remains a symbol of human achievement in space exploration. \\[Blank Line] What do you think was the most significant contribution of the Space Shuttle program? \\[Blank Line] Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
